title: Scalable fault vulnerability analysis for ReRAM-based process-in-memory CNN accelerators
abstract: arXiv:2611.26307v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Resistive random-access memory (ReRAM)-based processing-in-memory (PIM) accelerators offer a highly efficient platform for parallel matrix-vector multiplications (VMM) in neural networks, leveraging analog computation, high density, low leakage, and non-volatility. However, their susceptibility to permanent faults, such as stuck-at-high (\textit{SaH}) and stuck-at-low (\textit{SaL}) resistance states, permanently corrupts the convolutional neural networks (CNNs) weights mapped onto ReRAM cell conductance values, thereby degrading inference accuracy and leading to system unreliability in safety-critical applications. translated_title: 面向基于阻变存储器（ReRAM）的存内处理CNN加速器的可扩展故障脆弱性分析
translated_abstract: 基于阻变随机存取存储器（ReRAM）的存内处理（PIM）加速器，凭借模拟计算、高密度、低泄漏和非易失性等特性，为神经网络中的并行矩阵-向量乘法（VMM）提供了高效的平台。然而，这类加速器易受永久性故障的影响，例如高阻态卡死和低阻态卡死故障，这些故障会永久性地破坏映射到ReRAM单元电导值上的卷积神经网络（CNN）权重，从而降低推理精度，并在安全关键应用中导致系统不可靠。故障注入是一种常用的神经网络脆弱性评估技术，它通过系统性地向单个参数注入故障并测量由此产生的精度下降来评估网络。尽管这种方法精确，但其极其耗时且计算开销巨大，尤其是对于大型网络。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种可扩展的故障脆弱性分析方法，用于高效评估基于ReRAM的存内处理CNN加速器中永久性故障对推理精度的影响，克服了传统故障注入方法耗时且计算成本过高的缺点。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a scalable fault vulnerability analysis method to efficiently assess the impact of permanent faults on inference accuracy in ReRAM-based process-in-memory CNN accelerators, overcoming the prohibitive time and computational costs of traditional fault injection.
